capture.method: charts-copy capture thread, req 930010-930041, fresh Hudiy device
capture.note: 0101 and 0141 returned IDENTICAL bytes (4101000EA800 / 4141000EA800) — since-clear == this-drive-cycle, expected with no recent code clear

decode.B: 0x0E => B3=1 CONFIRMS DIESEL per J1979; common tests: misfire unavailable(complete), fuel system available+complete, comprehensive components available+complete
decode.C: 0xA8 (10101000b) => diesel-specific availability: boost pressure + exhaust gas sensor + EGR/VVT available; NMHC/NOx-SCR/PM-filter bits 0
decode.D: 0x00 => all available diesel monitors COMPLETE (completeness bit 0 = complete)

0101_readiness_since_clear.significance: readiness wall data model verified live: the app must read B3 for diesel-vs-petrol naming, C for availability, D for completeness; 'supported but incomplete' is the only state that counts against a verdict

0141_readiness_this_cycle.significance: 0141 supported (per 0140 bitmap) => two-group readiness wall (since-clear + this-cycle) is implementable on this car

app_rules: Diesel monitor naming per EPA/J1979 2010+ diesel map; B3 selects the naming table at runtime (universal rule)
Availability bit (C) and completeness bit (D) are separate; completeness 0 = complete, 1 = incomplete
Not-available monitors (NMHC/NOx/PM on this car via this ECU) render neutral 'not available', never counted as incomplete
